title: About Us
description: We know that standing out in today's market is hard. That is why OKAWE Media brings your business vision to life. We focus on telling your story through high-quality video and design.

team.name: Oliver OKAWE
team.bio:
Oliver OKAWE, Managing Director and Creative Lead at OKAWE Media, an agency specializing in high-impact digital marketing, corporate brand identity, and advanced motion graphics. With a strong foundation in Computer Software Engineering, he bridges strategic commercial vision with high-fidelity visual and technical execution.

Oliver has a proven track record of driving market visibility across West Africa, leading successful marketing initiatives and structural business proposals for multinational brands and corporate partners, including AEY Group (BOSCH Ghana), Total Energies partner, Tampico Ghana, and financial institution branches like SDSL (UMB Bank). Backed by specialized industry credentials in SEO and investor pitching from Semrush Academy and the Agence Française de Développement, he crafts multi-channel marketing campaigns and immersive 3D product animations that measurably scale small-to-medium businesses and enterprise clients alike.
